newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson Brazil a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson Brazil a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc and local associate Banco Patrimonio reiterated their buy recommendation on Ericsson Telecomunicacoes SA, the Brazilian unit of Swedish giant Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson.

-- Patrimonio analyst Ricardo Gurman said in a report that Ericsson's first-half net income of 101 million reais, up 57 percent from the period last year, was in line with expectations and his estimate for a 1997 profit of 228 million reais.
-- He also cited a surge in orders for the telecoms equipment manufacturer.

-- "In the second quarter, booked orders amounted to 612 million reais -- a 287-percent growth year-on-year -- and by the end of June the company's backlog amounted to 1.8 billion reais," Gurman wrote.
-- At 69 reais, the company's preferred stock is trading at 12.8 times and 11.6 times his 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates respectively, he added.
-- Ericsson preferred was up 0.29 percent at 68.90 reais while its common 5.58 percent at 54.90 reais at 1123 local/1023 EDT/1423 GMT in Sao Paulo.
